Who are you is authentication. Failing it is a 401.

model.text: Permissions go to roles, not to people.
An editor may read and write articles, but not delete them.
Give Maya the editor role, and she gets exactly that.

flow.text: Maya signs in. The login service checks her password and loads her roles.
It returns a signed token that carries those roles.
Every request brings that token to the API gateway.

flow.text: The gateway checks the signature and the expiry.
The policy check turns her roles into permissions.
Allowed: the request reaches the service, and the decision is logged.

Editors can't delete, so the answer is 403 Forbidden.
